question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Turn a deaf ear

options.text: Shout to be heard by someone

solution:
Here the correct answer is **Ignore what someone says.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of the given idiom:-
 
• **Turn a deaf ear** - refuse to listen or respond to a statement or request. (किसी कथन या अनुरोध को सुनने या प्रतिक्रिया देने से इंकार करना) 
 
 
• For Example - He **turned a deaf ear **to all appeals.
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

39:T891,

Here the correct answer is **Inevitable**.
